arm_descriptions.description: the robot settles a choice between two equally good places by their names, largest last, and starts a blind hunt with every place equally likely -- the settings every published number was measured under
the robot settles a choice between two equally good places with a key derived from the hunt's own identity, so the choice carries no information and two runs of one episode agree
the robot takes the head of the planner's own list instead, i.e. the smallest name; measured as an upper bound on what a lucky name order is worth, never as a candidate default
with nothing known about this object, the robot starts from its own record of where things of that kind have turned up, smoothed with the uniform prior over the places this world offers

grading: correct = the robot committed and the place it committed to is the hidden truth; wrong = it committed elsewhere; no_verdict = it never committed within the budget
note: no mind is carried from one episode to the next here, as the committed sweep does not carry one either, so the record of where kinds of things turn up is empty in every episode of every arm
